_doc: Documented exceptions of the organization source guards. Every entry needs an owner and a reason, and a stale entry (the token no longer appears) fails the guard.

allow.reason: type-level placeholder in `type Need`: no capability uses it and it is not a canonical permission (backend access/Permission.kt CANONICAL has no ORG_*). Remove when C1 names the capability in H-C1-17; until then nothing may rely on it.
